Olenko sopiva tähän työhön? Räätälöi ansioluetteloni The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you! Job Description The University of Notre Dame is a place where milestones are celebrated, traditions are honored, and community is strengthened through shared experiences. The University Events team plays a vital role in this mission by bringing people together through academic, athletic, social, alumni, and celebratory events. Reporting to the Director of Social & Wedding Events, the Event Specialist serves as a trusted partner and resource for internal constituents and external clients. This role directly impacts the campus experience by transforming a client's vision into a seamless event. The Event Specialist plans and executes a diverse portfolio of events, including university traditions, football weekends, alumni gatherings, milestone celebrations, recognition events, conferences, departmental functions, private celebrations, and signature campus experiences. A primary focus during the peak wedding season in June and July is the planning and execution of weddings. The Event Specialist manages multiple concurrent events, oversees logistics, monitors budgets, coordinates campus and vendor resources, and delivers exceptional customer service throughout the event lifecycle. As a liaison between clients and catering providers, this role develops customized event experiences that align with client goals, preferences, and budgets. Responsibilities include overseeing menu planning, service delivery, accommodations, and event flow to ensure every detail is executed with precision. The successful candidate will guide clients through a consultative planning process, develop detailed event proposals, and manage events from concept through completion. This includes coordinating campus services such as catering, facilities, information technology, audiovisual support, transportation, lodging, and public safety; managing vendor relationships and contracts; resolving operational challenges; and providing on-site event management. The Event Specialist must balance competing priorities, adapt to last-minute changes, and deliver memorable experiences that reflect the University's commitment to excellence, hospitality, and community. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience. Professional experience in event planning, hospitality, project coordination, university events, or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing events from planning through execution, including timeline development, stakeholder coordination, and budget oversight. Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills, with the ability to guide clients through a consultative planning process. Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines. Ability to negotiate contracts, manage vendor relationships, and collaborate effectively with departments and service providers. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond calmly and effectively to operational challenges, emergencies, and changing event needs. Availability to support evening and weekend events, including football weekends, major university events, and peak event seasons. Preferred Qualifications Experience coordinating social events, milestone celebrations, athletic events, alumni gatherings, conferences, academic ceremonies, or other high-touch events requiring extensive client interaction. Experience managing multiple large-scale events in a hospitality, venue, university, conference, or event management environment. Familiarity with higher education administrative structures, campus traditions, and university operations. Experience supporting football weekends, alumni engagement events, commencement activities, or other signature campus events. Knowledge of risk management principles, liability mitigation, and event licensing requirements. Additional Information Application Deadline to Apply: July 5, 2026 Hiring Pay Range: Up to $55,000 Annually | Commensurate with experience The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity. paragraphs:
Hei,

Olen kiinnostunut hakemaan tapahtujen erikoistajakokemusta yliopiston tilaisuuksissa University of Notre Dames joukkueessa. Minulla on LL.M. Business and Corporate Law (Symbiosis International University, 1. sija) ja käytännön kokemus sopimusvalmistelusta ja -muokkaamisesta yritysasiakasille. Viime aikoina olen tehnyt laajan työskentelyn suomenkielisen asianajotoiminnan parissa Oulussa, mikä on antanut minulle syvän käsityksen paikallisten oikeusprosessien toiminnasta ja menetelmistä.

Yliopiston tapahtujen erikoistajakokemus olisi merkittävä lisääminen CV:niin. Haluaisin hyödyntää mahdollisuutta osallistua yliopiston sisällä toimivaan oikeudelliseen työskentelyyn ja saada kokemusta monipuolisista tapahtumiprojektista, joiden tavoitteena on vahvistaa yhteisön tunnetta ja yhdessä viettämistä.
Olen valmis aloittamaan työskentelyn syyskuussa 2026 ja voimassa olevilla ehdoilla. Toivon voivan esittää henkilötietoni ja CV:nne tarkemmin, niin että voitte arvioida minua kandidaatiksi.

Odotan kuulevani sinulta mahdollisuudesta osallistua University of Notre Dames joukkueeseen.

Hyvää päivää,
Ystävällisin terveisin
